course_name_original: Methods and Tools for Managerial Decisionmaking
course_name_en: Methods and Tools for Managerial Decisionmaking

learning_outcomes.text: Introduce key managerial counting needed in technical applications, specifically calculations required during new product development or innovation and for new or innovative processes or activities in industrial and manufacturing enterprises.
Present how these calculations are done, their key principles, and basic techniques.
Present and explain gained results and their application by typical managerial decisions.

syllabus_topics: The goals of the course. Its links to other courses. Why the calculations are needed for decision making. Key entities in Enterprise management system and their interactions. Cost control-basic principles and effective approach to Cost control.
Enterprise plans and budgets. Operational budget-the role, structure, creation and assessment.
Managerial approach to budgets – what is important. How to work with the deviations.
Product costing. Why and how to do costing. The link to price. Costing structure. Costing methods and techniques.
Hour cost tariff method-the alternatives and their application conditions and managerial effects.

Technical principles of accounting in enterprise. Its position from the managerial point of view. What is essential for technicians. Financial and internal accounting + interactions. Flexibility in accounting system – to responsibility and to product oriented accounting.
Management of the internal processes and its tools. The role of information systems.
Investment decision making and its methods. How can be influenced the decision according to the way of financing the investment project.
Target Costing (TC) and impact on technical work. Integrative face of TC.
Key managerial tools.
Management oriented to processes, to activities and to projects. How to fit them together. Value chain and its application.
Performance measurement. Key performance indicators (scales) and their link to products, processes and activities.
Summary. Discussion to key topics of the course.
Explanation to the goals of the seminars. Program and rules. Creation of the student’s teams. Starting suggestion of the model enterprise parameters for each team.
Key costing calculations. Solving cases.
Operational budget (OP) 1: OP-Creation on the base of Activities interactions and specification of resources. Capacity calculation. Cost items counting scheme.
Operational budget (OP) 2: OP-Items analyses. Alternative solutions for each OP-item. Impacts on costs and capacity plan. AZSEMMM
Operational budget (OP) 3: OP-Variations analysis. Managerial interpretations.
Costing methods and techniques. Costing scheme. Hour Cost Tariff Method-1.
Hour Cost Tariff Method-2. Alternatives and their managerial application.
Other costing method and their application areas.
Three balance system and linked calculations. Accounting system alternatives.
Internal recording of non-financial measures and their managerial importance.
Target Costing Methodology + its links.
Investment projects calculations and ways of its financing. Managerial analysis.
Conclusions. Crediting.
